vibe_rationale: Long-running, community-trusted camping festival at a cult venue with a curated lineup, but a single music format and minimal brand presence.
fit_notes: Adult camping crowd over a long weekend with real scene loyalty, but demographics are unpublished and brand presence is minimal. The only route is a general email and a publicity page, with no named partners. Any approach would need to be culture-first, such as camping or recovery amenities, rather than signage.
